name: @oodle/inbox
description: The remote inbox: a Cloudflare Worker serving the sync API, the UI API and the web app

scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.web.json && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && tsc -p tsconfig.node.json
scripts.deploy: vite build && wrangler d1 migrations apply oodle-inbox --remote && wrangler deploy
